stories.disposition: Recovery sequencing (11 ACs, highest complexity, crash-safety-critical). Authored real IDB checkpoint-store + deferred-store (IDS ONLY, known-lossy R2 SETTLED) + createPersistenceAdapter() composing S4 raw-event-log-store + checkpoint + deferred into one production PersistenceAdapter; acceptDeferredFact = accepted-first crash-safe ordering (append accepted THEN atomic updateItem deferred-remove; crash-between leaves fact in BOTH stores, R2a prunes accepted-wins), clearGroupState = checkpoint-first (crash mid-reset degrades to L1/L2, never stranded bootstrapCompleted over emptied logs; generation-recheck closes the setItem TOCTOU with no await between recheck and transaction-creation). R1-R4 wired into receive-engine.ts (much built best-effort S5/S6; ingestPersisted drives R3). Found+fixed a real AC-PERS-2 conformance bug: degradation reason was cleared during the always-nominal recovering lifecycle -> moved clear to enterCatchingUp after its checkpoint save (health genuinely degraded through catching_up until first successful save; targeted clear doesn't touch S6 ref-counted persistence-failure degradation). Stage-1 Opus CLEAN (0 findings). Stage-2 Fable: 1 finding (sev-3 testing) — the dedicated AC-INV-3 epoch-carve-out test was a tautology (buildProjection([A,B])===buildProjection([A,B]), never touched the engine) -> replaced with an engine-level test driving real createReceiveEngine across stop/restart with an epoch-crossing deferred fact + decryptable sibling, non-vacuity proven by 3-way fixture mutation. Both models upheld all crash-safety claims. Protocol guard HELD (local persistence/recovery only, no wire/convergence change). R-INV-1 (seq/membership, never id) property-tested; own boundary edges (persistence -> engine-types only) clean.

stories.disposition: Optimistic local echo at the engine boundary (spec Layer 4). acceptLocal(rumorId, payload) folds a locally-authored TaskEvent into the accepted-log + domain_event_accepted stream keyed by eventId=deriveMlsAcceptedEventId(rumorId) (identity fn = the exact rumorId the outbox sends); appends NO RawProtocolFact, never advances lastIngestedSeq, factId='local:${rumorId}' placeholder (inert in R2a/recovery); dedupe via appendAcceptedEvent idempotency + hasProcessed; race-safe via enqueue() reading generation at execution time; flag-safe (no-op when engine unmounted). AC-OPT-3 convergence: no merge logic in acceptLocal -> deep-equals remote-only via shared applyEvent/taskWinsOver (commutative under 3-level LWW total order; losing own-edit correctly superseded, not sticky). Durable across restart (AC-OPT-2). Stage-1 Opus: sev-3 pending-signal not reachable by useTaskStore -> threaded pendingTaskIds into TaskStoreContextValue (pass-through, dispatch unchanged, flag-OFF empty). Stage-2 Fable: F1(sev-3) pending could stick forever + ref-Map leak (confirmLocal only on reconcile) -> onReconciled renamed onPendingCleared (fires reconciled|failed) + new eviction hook from enforceOutboxCap -> clears in all 3 terminal cases, idempotent, unregistered on dispose, failed!=confirmed (separate taskPublishFailed event); F2(sev-2) added direct LWW supersession tests. Both models converge-verified clean. Protocol guard HELD (deriveMlsAcceptedEventId identity, no wire/convergence change). task-store dispatch() body UNCHANGED (Boundary Rule 5) — the legacy optimistic apply/appendEvent stays (feeds flag-OFF path) until S12 removes it.

THE FULL LEGACY->ENGINE CUTOVER (user-authorized). Retired device-sync's group.ingest() receive DRIVER (kind-445 sub + group.ingest) + persistence-side applicationMessage listener (KEPT publish/outbox/bootstrap/device helpers); removed task-store's applicationMessage listener + legacy state + legacy activeRead branch + legacy optimistic apply/persist in dispatch; engine mounts UNCONDITIONALLY (S9 flag-gate dropped from mount, flag vestigial for S13); wired correct ORIGIN ROUTING (restored when checkpoint!=null OR acceptedEvents.length>0, else welcome) so reload recovers from the durable accepted-log not re-bootstrap; added 'recovering' to ENGINE_LOADING_LIFECYCLES; retired persistence.ts legacy notestr:events path. DISCOVERED+FIXED a real latent gap: S11's durable createPersistenceAdapter had NEVER been wired into production (S9 ran on a non-durable session-scoped interim) — S12 is its first production use. AC-MIG-3: 0 applicationMessage in task-store.tsx. Engine is now the SOLE group.ingest() driver (dual-ingest hazard CLOSED); reconcileOwnEcho runs in the shipped config. Stage-1 Opus: S12-1(sev-5 re-join reset gap — forget-device->re-invite misrouted to restored->stale state; RULED NON-BLOCKING: legacy was equally broken, not a regression; deferred-fact symptom cap-bounded 500; HIGH-PRIORITY tracked follow-up) + S12-2(sev-3 origin-proxy weakness -> widened to checkpoint||logs-non-empty, closes Constraint-12 bypass). Fable independently confirmed S12-1 non-blocking. Both models converge-verified clean on S12-2 + S12-Fable-1. Protocol guard HELD. watch_items: S12-1 OPEN (sev-5, HIGH-PRIORITY FOLLOW-UP, ruled non-blocking by BOTH models — NOT a regression, legacy was equally broken): RE-JOIN RESET GAP. A forget-device->re-invite (new MLS Welcome for a group that already has durable engine state) is misrouted to origin:'restored' (a stale checkpoint from prior membership exists), so the engine L1-recovers the STALE pre-removal accepted-log + R3-replays now-undecryptable old-epoch facts (park in deferred, cap-bounded 500), and NEVER fetches the fresh kind-30078 bootstrap carrying current LWW-merged state -> re-joining device strands on stale/partial state. FIX (new follow-up story, MUST land before forget-device->re-invite is advertised as fully supported): detect re-join at the integration layer (the layer knows fresh-Welcome vs rehydrated-persisted — NOT inferable from checkpoint existence) and route it through stop()->reset()->start('welcome') per architecture.md 'Re-join and Reset' / ADR-002. EngineTaskBridge currently only remounts on a groupId CHANGE, never a same-group re-join.

S12 PREREQUISITES — DELIVERED (closed): device-sync group.ingest DRIVER retired (engine is SOLE ingest driver, dual-ingest hazard CLOSED); reconcileOwnEcho runs in the shipped config (engine unconditional); legacy dispatch optimistic-apply/appendEvent removed; 'recovering' added to ENGINE_LOADING_LIFECYCLES; real durable createPersistenceAdapter wired into production (was non-durable interim). Move it onto a per-client/per-identity instance owned by the adapter/engine so identity teardown is structural, not a manually-invoked module-global clear.

ENABLEMENT (sev-2, from S10): task-store outbox mount has a transient startup window (deps-ready -> loadPersisted-settled, ~1 IDB read) where a dispatch skips its MLS send (applies optimistically + legacy-persists, no re-send) — same class as pre-S10 if(group) gate. Closing it needs a publish()-internal rehydration gate in publish-outbox.ts (queue-until-rehydrated); fold into S12 convergence if the startup send-gap matters once the engine path is primary.

ENABLEMENT (sev-2, from S9 Opus converge): task-store ENGINE_LOADING_LIFECYCLES = {uninitialized,joining,catching_up} omits 'recovering' — CORRECT while ENGINE_START_OPTIONS is hardcoded origin:'welcome' (recovering unreachable, L2 path only), but MUST add 'recovering' when the restored-origin path is enabled (deferred per S9 judgment call engine-origin-hardcoded-to-welcome; S11 lands restored-origin recovery).

S8-hook (sev-3, from S9): useReceiveEngine returns an unmemoized {projection,engineState,lastRejection} object literal every render — consumer footgun (naive whole-object dep = infinite render loop, already OOM-killed a vitest worker; S9 worked around it by depending on individual fields). Memoize the hook's return (useMemo on the three fields) so the container is referentially stable. Low urgency (task-store is the only consumer this epic), retro/backlog candidate.

ENABLEMENT (sev-2, from S9): the engine holds the mount-time MarmotGroup and only remounts on key={groupId} change; a MarmotGroup-instance swap for the SAME groupId (re-join/forget-device re-invite) keeps a stale group ref. Confirm the composition root re-keys/remounts on group-instance identity change before the engine path is enabled in production.

S11/ENGINE OPEN (from S8 Fable F2, sev-4, conf~0.6): AC-INV-4 fold==rebuild DIVERGES when a bootstrap-sourced event is accepted AFTER an mls event for the same task (e.g. late fetchBootstrap completing post-T_join, with the mls task.created pruned by relay retention). Incremental fold uses acceptance order; buildProjection uses replayOrder (bootstrap-phase-first), so the live mls update can be silently lost until the next restart/invalidate. The S8 hook faithfully implements the mandated contract — the defect is at the EngineOutputEvent seam. FIX (engine-side, S11 or engine follow-up): emit projection_invalidated when a bootstrap-sourced event is accepted after the engine has left joining (late-bootstrap completion), folding it into the hook's existing rebuild path with no hook change. Retro/backlog candidate.

S8 CLOSED (was sev-6 projection_invalidated rebuild-race): generation-token supersession + eventsSinceRebuildStart queued-replay + F1-read try/catch + F3 replay-dedupe all remediated & two-model converge-verified.

S9 (consumer contract, pressure relieved): useReceiveEngine effect keyed on [groupId] only; unstable createEngine/persistence/startOptions identities no longer churn the engine (F2/F4 fixes). Still: key the component by groupId for group switches; createEngine factory + any adapter it builds MUST be side-effect-free until engine.start() (StrictMode throwaway is stopped from uninitialized, adapter never closed).

A GENUINE task-kind rumor with missing/mistyped required fields -> malformed -> domain_event_rejected{parse_error} (S7 Codex-P1 per-variant validation). S8 UI must render parse_error rejections gracefully (rejection-reason-vocabulary: parse_error, retry-exhausted, deferred-ttl-expired, persistence-exhausted, unknown).

S8 (live-path silent loss, from S7 F4): marmot-adapter openLive() live-event ingest is fire-and-forget; an unexpected group.ingest throw is console.warn-swallowed with NO engine-observable signal (IngestSignal has no error variant). Consider whether a live-path ingest throw should mark engine health degraded (Impl Constraint 11 spirit) — needs a new engine-observable error channel/seam variant, out of S7 scope.

Non-crashing, tie-break-safe, group-member-trust-bounded. Only revisit if projector trust model widens beyond authenticated members.
